MaxBattery.Notes: Render at 960x600 and let FSR upscale to the panel — this is the only way to keep the TDP low enough for meaningful battery life. Anti-cheat may block online play regardless of these settings.

KnownIssues: Anti-cheat (EasyAntiCheat) may block online multiplayer entirely on Linux/Proton, making the game's primary modes unplayable.

No community-verified Proton version has been confirmed to reliably run the game; GE-Proton is the best current option.

MaxPerformance.Notes: At full TDP the Deck can push into the 50s in lighter scenes, but expect drops into the 40s in busy combined-arms engagements — do not expect a locked 60. Battery life will be very short at this setting.
